boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Cal Poly Maritime Academy
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe food runs around Vallejo and nearby American Canyon, each verified through a current official location page showing service at midnight or later.

cards.title: The All-Night Solano Stop
cards.subtitle: A 24-hour drive-through option in central Vallejo
cards.notes: Use the Solano Avenue drive-through when the timing is unpredictable; confirm holiday service in the app before leaving campus.
cards.short_summary: A continuously operating drive-through for meals at virtually any hour.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell's official location page identifies the restaurant at 2033 Solano Avenue and lists drive-through hours as 12:00 AM–12:00 AM every day.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Vallejo, CA — 2033 Solano Avenue
cards.access_notes: The official page lists the drive-through as open 24 hours daily. Late-night access is drive-through service; holiday hours may vary.

cards.entity_name: Jack in the Box — 400 Broadway Street
cards.title: Broadway After Midnight
cards.subtitle: All-night drive-through service on Vallejo's west side
cards.notes: Choose the Broadway drive-through after the 10:00 PM lobby closure, and check the official page again before a holiday trip.
cards.short_summary: A west-Vallejo option whose drive-through continues after its dining room closes.
cards.evidence_claim: Jack in the Box's official page identifies the 400 Broadway Street restaurant and displays drive-through hours as 4:00 AM–4:00 AM daily.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box — 400 Broadway St, Vallejo
cards.access_notes: Drive-through service is listed as 24 hours daily. The lobby is listed from 6:00 AM to 10:00 PM, so late access requires a vehicle.

cards.entity_name: Jack in the Box — 1610 Lewis Brown Drive
cards.title: The Lewis Brown Overnight Run
cards.subtitle: A 24-hour drive-through near northern Vallejo
cards.notes: Plan on drive-through access after 10:00 PM; use the official location page to recheck service before setting out late.
cards.short_summary: An overnight northern-Vallejo run with a separately documented lobby cutoff.
cards.evidence_claim: The official Jack in the Box page lists 1610 Lewis Brown Drive and shows drive-through hours of 4:00 AM–4:00 AM seven days a week.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box — 1610 Lewis Brown Dr, Vallejo
cards.access_notes: The drive-through is listed as operating 24 hours daily; the lobby closes at 10:00 PM each night.

cards.entity_name: Jack in the Box — 35 Admiral Callaghan Lane
cards.title: Admiral Callaghan After Hours
cards.subtitle: All-night drive-through service east of downtown Vallejo
cards.notes: Use this branch by vehicle after its 9:00 PM lobby closure, and verify current hours online before making the cross-town run.
cards.short_summary: A late drive-through whose dining room closes earlier than nearby branches.
cards.evidence_claim: Jack in the Box's official page lists the 35 Admiral Callaghan Lane location with drive-through hours of 4:00 AM–4:00 AM every day.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box — 35 Admiral Callaghan Ln, Vallejo
cards.access_notes: Drive-through service is listed as 24 hours daily. The lobby closes at 9:00 PM, making a vehicle necessary later at night.

cards.title: The 24-Hour Sonoma Boulevard Window
cards.subtitle: Round-the-clock drive-through service in north Vallejo
cards.notes: Treat this as a vehicle-based run after the lobby period; check the restaurant page for temporary or holiday changes first.
cards.short_summary: A continuously available drive-through on one of Vallejo's main north–south routes.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald's official restaurant page identifies 3289 Sonoma Boulevard and lists its drive-through as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday.
cards.source_title: McDonald's — 3289 Sonoma Blvd, Vallejo
cards.access_notes: The drive-through is officially listed as open 24 hours every day. Lobby hours are more limited, so do not assume indoor late-night access.

cards.title: Sonoma Boulevard's 3:00 AM Window
cards.subtitle: Drive-through service until 2:00 or 3:00 AM
cards.notes: Save this for a Friday or Saturday 3:00 AM cutoff; on other nights, plan to arrive before the listed 2:00 AM close.
cards.short_summary: A weekend-oriented late run with later Friday and Saturday drive-through hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell's official page lists drive-through service at 3600 Sonoma Boulevard until 2:00 AM Sunday–Thursday and 3:00 AM Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Vallejo, CA — 3600 Sonoma Blvd
cards.access_notes: Drive-through hours end at 2:00 AM Sunday–Thursday and 3:00 AM Friday–Saturday. The official page shows much earlier dine-in hours.

cards.title: The 1:30 AM Weekend Run
cards.subtitle: Dine-in and drive-through service past midnight
cards.notes: Arrive before 1:00 AM on weeknights or 1:30 AM Friday and Saturday; verify special-day hours on the location page.
cards.short_summary: A late destination with both dine-in seating and drive-through access documented.
cards.evidence_claim: In-N-Out's official Vallejo page lists normal hours until 1:00 AM Sunday–Thursday and 1:30 AM Friday–Saturday, with dine-in and drive-through available.
cards.source_title: In-N-Out Burger — Vallejo, 720 Admiral Callaghan Ln
cards.access_notes: Normal hours are 10:30 AM–1:00 AM Sunday–Thursday and 10:30 AM–1:30 AM Friday–Saturday; dine-in and drive-through are listed.

cards.title: Redwood Street Until 1:00 AM
cards.subtitle: Restaurant and drive-through hours align nightly
cards.notes: Use this for a before-1:00 AM stop and leave enough time to order; recheck the page because holiday schedules can differ.
cards.short_summary: A consistent seven-night option with both restaurant and drive-through hours shown.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's official page lists the restaurant at 1001 Redwood Street as open from 6:30 AM to 1:00 AM every day, with identical drive-through hours.
cards.source_title: Wendy's Vallejo — 1001 Redwood
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-through service are both listed until 1:00 AM seven days a week. The page cautions that holiday hours may vary.

cards.title: The Midnight Fairgrounds Diner
cards.subtitle: A sit-down option serving through midnight
cards.notes: Choose this when indoor seating matters, but arrive well before the midnight close and confirm same-day hours before traveling.
cards.short_summary: A late sit-down alternative to the area's drive-through-heavy overnight choices.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny's official location page identifies the restaurant at 250 Fairgrounds Drive and lists daily restaurant hours from 6:00 AM to 12:00 AM.
cards.source_title: Denny's — 250 Fairgrounds Dr, Vallejo
cards.access_notes: The official restaurant schedule runs until 12:00 AM daily. Arrive before closing and contact the location to confirm holiday hours.

cards.entity_name: Jack in the Box — 107 West American Canyon Road
cards.title: The American Canyon Overnight Detour
cards.subtitle: A 24-hour lobby and drive-through north of Vallejo
cards.notes: Use this farther north option when walk-in access matters overnight; verify the live page before committing to the extra distance.
cards.short_summary: A nearby overnight destination with late lobby access documented, not only a drive-through.
cards.evidence_claim: Jack in the Box's official page identifies 107 West American Canyon Road and lists both lobby and drive-through hours as 4:00 AM–4:00 AM daily.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box — 107 W American Canyon Rd
cards.access_notes: Both lobby and drive-through are listed as operating 24 hours daily. This destination is in American Canyon, north of Vallejo.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Solano Campus places for studying, meeting, recreation, events, and waterfront breaks, verified through current university pages and the official campus map.

cards.title: Set Up for Solo or Group Work at the Library
cards.subtitle: Lower-campus study space with research help and shared resources
cards.notes: Bring coursework here for individual or group study, then use the service desk or virtual chat when research questions stall.
cards.short_summary: A lower-campus workspace combining study areas, research support, computers, Wi-Fi, and printing.
cards.evidence_claim: Cal Poly states that the Solano campus library provides individual and group study space, research assistance, Wi-Fi, computers, and self-service printing.
cards.source_title: Library Services | Cal Poly Academic Catalog
cards.access_notes: Use during posted library hours; some materials, borrowing privileges, and licensed resources may require Cal Poly credentials.

cards.title: Use Mayo Hall Between Appointments and Meetings
cards.subtitle: Student-life center with lounges, study areas, and meeting rooms
cards.notes: Use the lounge or study areas between classes, or meet here before visiting the student-service offices housed in the building.
cards.short_summary: A renovated historic gym repurposed around student services, informal gathering, studying, and leadership work.
cards.evidence_claim: The university says Mayo Hall now contains student-oriented lounge, study, meeting, leadership, and student-service spaces.
cards.source_title: Mayo Hall Renovation and Addition Project
cards.access_notes: Building and room access may follow campus business hours, scheduled programs, or reservations; confirm locally before arranging a meeting.

cards.title: Split a Workout Across PEAC’s Fitness Spaces
cards.subtitle: Weight room, cardio room, and pool in one campus facility
cards.notes: Check the current recreation schedule, bring the required gear, and choose the weight room, cardio room, or pool for your session.
cards.short_summary: The campus recreation complex brings strength, cardio, and aquatic facilities under one roof.
cards.evidence_claim: Cal Maritime identifies PEAC activities as including a weight room, cardio room, and pool; ASI lists PEAC among its managed student facilities.
cards.source_title: Associated Students | Cal Poly Maritime Academy
cards.access_notes: Facility participation is subject to current ASI schedules, eligibility rules, Port Pass requirements, and any pool safety restrictions.

cards.title: Meet Teammates on Bodnar Field
cards.subtitle: ASI-managed outdoor field for recreation and campus programs
cards.notes: Check the ASI calendar or field schedule before organizing a game, practice, or outdoor meetup so you do not conflict with programming.
cards.short_summary: A named athletic field used within the academy’s student recreation and event network.
cards.evidence_claim: Cal Poly Maritime Academy says ASI manages Bodnar Field to support student connection and recreation; the official campus map labels it as location 35.
cards.source_title: Associated Students | Cal Poly Maritime Academy
cards.access_notes: Use depends on scheduled athletics, intramurals, events, field conditions, and current ASI facility rules.

cards.title: Take a Waterfront Reset at Morrow Cove
cards.subtitle: ASI-managed waterfront campus space
cards.notes: Use the cove as a meetup or outdoor pause, while staying within posted boundaries and leaving active waterfront operations undisturbed.
cards.short_summary: A distinctly maritime outdoor gathering place beside San Pablo Bay and the campus waterfront.
cards.evidence_claim: Cal Poly Maritime Academy lists Morrow Cove as an ASI-managed campus space for students to connect and recharge; it is also named on the official campus map.
cards.source_title: Associated Students | Cal Poly Maritime Academy
cards.access_notes: Observe posted waterfront boundaries, weather conditions, event closures, and campus safety instructions; water access is not implied.

cards.title: Bring a Small Group to the Sport Courts
cards.subtitle: Outdoor courts managed for student recreation
cards.notes: Check court availability, bring the right ball or equipment, and use the space for an informal game when scheduled programs are clear.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated outdoor court area for active breaks, informal play, and organized recreation.
cards.evidence_claim: The academy says ASI manages the Sport Courts for student connection and activity; the official campus map names the site All Sports Courts.
cards.source_title: Associated Students | Cal Poly Maritime Academy
cards.access_notes: Court availability is subject to intramurals, programs, maintenance, weather, and current ASI rules.

cards.title: Use Formation Quad as the Clear Group Rally Point
cards.subtitle: Large named outdoor campus gathering area
cards.notes: Pick a specific edge or landmark before meeting here; the quad’s large capacity makes precise meetup instructions especially useful.
cards.short_summary: A central open space suited to large assemblies and clearly coordinated campus meetups.
cards.evidence_claim: Cal Maritime’s official meeting-spaces page identifies Formation Quad as an outdoor space with a listed capacity of 750.
cards.source_title: Meeting Spaces - CSUM
cards.access_notes: Formal events require coordination or reservation; routine access may change for formations, ceremonies, or campus operations.

cards.title: Choose Felton Garden for a Smaller Outdoor Meetup
cards.subtitle: Named garden beside the Charlotte Felton House
cards.notes: Use this smaller setting for a planned conversation or group pause, and verify that no reserved event is using the garden first.
cards.short_summary: A defined garden venue offering a more contained alternative to the campus’s broad lawns and quad.
cards.evidence_claim: Cal Maritime’s official meeting-spaces page lists Felton Garden as an outdoor space with a capacity of 64.
cards.source_title: Meeting Spaces - CSUM
cards.access_notes: Event use may require a reservation and fees; confirm availability with campus Conference and Events.

cards.title: Move the Conversation Outside the Dining Center
cards.subtitle: Named lawn for outdoor gatherings near campus dining
cards.notes: Meet on the lawn for an outdoor group check-in, but verify event bookings and keep service routes and building entrances clear.
cards.short_summary: A mapped gathering lawn that gives groups outdoor space beside a major daily campus destination.
cards.evidence_claim: Cal Maritime’s official meeting-spaces page names the Lawn at Dining Center as an outdoor venue with a capacity of 200.
cards.source_title: Meeting Spaces - CSUM
cards.access_notes: The lawn may be reserved for events; dining purchases and meal access are separate from use of the outdoor area.

cards.title: Take a Short Break at the Overlook
cards.subtitle: Named outdoor venue above the waterfront campus
cards.notes: Use the Overlook for a brief outdoor conversation or reset, then yield the space when a scheduled campus event is being prepared.
cards.short_summary: A compact named outdoor venue suited to pauses and small-group gatherings away from indoor rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: Cal Maritime’s official meeting-spaces page lists the Overlook among campus outdoor spaces and assigns it a capacity of 80.
cards.source_title: Meeting Spaces - CSUM
cards.access_notes: Confirm the exact location on campus wayfinding and respect reservations, barriers, weather closures, and posted safety rules.

warnings: Several supporting facility pages remain on the university’s legacy csum.edu domain during the Cal Poly integration; all cited URLs are direct university pages.
Coordinates and Google Maps URLs are null because exact destination-level values were not verified from authoritative direct pages.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten verified campus and Vallejo settings for quiet reading, group work, research, advising, or laptop sessions, with access constraints noted.

cards.title: Cal Maritime Library
cards.subtitle: Quiet work, group projects, and waterfront views
cards.notes: Settle in for focused reading or group work, and borrow available study tools such as laptops, whiteboards, chargers, or calculators.
cards.short_summary: A campus library supporting both concentrated individual work and collaborative assignments.
cards.evidence_claim: The university says the library provides quiet-study and group-work space, waterfront views, wireless access, computers, charging stations, printers, mobile whiteboards, and loanable equipment.
cards.source_title: 2023–24 Cal Maritime Faculty Handbook
cards.access_notes: Use is subject to the Solano Campus Library's posted operating hours and current library policies.

cards.entity_name: Mayo Hall Upstairs Quiet Study Area
cards.title: Upstairs Quiet Study Area
cards.subtitle: A designated quiet zone inside Mayo Hall
cards.notes: Bring reading or an individual assignment upstairs when you want a university-designated quiet setting away from group conversation.
cards.short_summary: A specifically documented quiet-study area in the renovated student-life building.
cards.evidence_claim: The university's Mayo Hall renovation page labels an interior photograph as the “Upstairs quiet study area” and says the building contains student-oriented study space.
cards.source_title: Mayo Hall Renovation and Addition Project
cards.access_notes: The source documents the space but does not publish separate access hours or eligibility rules; follow posted Mayo Hall access notices.

cards.title: Mayo Hall Informal Study Spaces
cards.subtitle: Flexible seating for collaborative assignments
cards.notes: Use the informal areas for a project check-in or shared notes, leaving the documented upstairs quiet area to independent work.
cards.short_summary: Flexible student-oriented areas for work that benefits from conversation and movement.
cards.evidence_claim: The university says renovated Mayo Hall houses lounge, study, meeting, leadership, and informal social spaces for students.
cards.source_title: Mayo Hall Renovation and Addition Project
cards.access_notes: The source does not specify reservations or public access; use only areas open to you and yield reserved meeting spaces.

cards.title: SEAS Center
cards.subtitle: A Student Services stop for academic planning
cards.notes: Bring your degree plan or a difficult scheduling question and use a one-on-one advising visit to map the next concrete study steps.
cards.short_summary: A practical planning stop when the work is deciding what to study and in what order.
cards.evidence_claim: The university advises students to stop by the SEAS Center in the Student Services Building for one-on-one university advising and academic action planning.
cards.source_title: Advising FAQs
cards.access_notes: Contact advisor@csum.edu for a quick question or schedule a one-on-one appointment; drop-in availability is not guaranteed.

cards.entity_name: Vallejo John F. Kennedy Library Group Study Rooms
cards.title: JFK Library Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Three first-come rooms for shared work
cards.notes: Arrive with your group and ask about an available room before spreading out materials; plan around the stated two-hour minimum-use window.
cards.short_summary: Enclosed public-library rooms suited to discussion-heavy assignments.
cards.evidence_claim: Solano County Library states that the Vallejo John F. Kennedy Library has three group study rooms available first come, first served, with groups able to use an available room for at least two hours.
cards.source_title: Vallejo John F. Kennedy Library
cards.access_notes: Rooms are first come, first served during library hours and intended for groups; an available group may use one for at least two hours.

cards.entity_name: Vallejo John F. Kennedy Library Public Computers
cards.title: JFK Library Computer Area
cards.subtitle: Microsoft Office, internet, scanning, and printing
cards.notes: Use a public workstation for Office-based coursework or online research, then scan supporting pages free or budget for printed copies.
cards.short_summary: A technology-equipped workspace for assignments that need more than a personal notebook.
cards.evidence_claim: The branch lists 30 public computers with Microsoft Office and internet access, three catalog/database computers, printers, a scanner, and wireless networking.
cards.source_title: Vallejo John F. Kennedy Library
cards.access_notes: Computer availability and session rules are managed by the branch; printing costs 20 cents per black-and-white page and 50 cents per color page.

cards.title: McCune Collection
cards.subtitle: Rare books and California print history
cards.notes: Use this first-floor collection for source-driven research on California, fine printing, or book arts, and ask staff before handling materials.
cards.short_summary: A specialized research setting for close study of rare books and printing history.
cards.evidence_claim: Solano County Library identifies the first-floor McCune Collection as a collection of rare books concerning California, fine printing, and the art of the book.
cards.source_title: Vallejo John F. Kennedy Library
cards.access_notes: The branch page does not state handling or appointment rules for the collection; confirm access with library staff before planning research.

cards.title: Springstowne Library
cards.subtitle: A smaller branch with computers and wireless access
cards.notes: Choose this branch for laptop research or an Office assignment, and use wireless printing when you need to send a file from your own device.
cards.short_summary: An east Vallejo library option with practical digital tools for coursework.
cards.evidence_claim: Solano County Library says Springstowne provides 13 internet-connected computers with Microsoft Office, a wireless network, a scanner, and wireless printing.
cards.source_title: Vallejo Springstowne Library
cards.access_notes: Computers and seating are subject to branch availability; the branch page does not identify reservable study rooms.

cards.title: Panama Bay Coffee Co.
cards.subtitle: Indoor and outdoor tables in the ferry building
cards.notes: Pair a reading block with the waterfront setting, choosing an indoor or outdoor table and respecting customer seating expectations.
cards.short_summary: A ferry-building café where a book or small-group review can fit around a purchase.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Vallejo describes Panama Bay Coffee Co. as a waterfront café in the Vallejo ferry building with indoor and outdoor seating and an in-house book library.
cards.source_title: Panama Bay Coffee Co.
cards.access_notes: This is a commercial café; seating is available during business hours and should be treated as customer seating.

cards.title: Moschetti Café
cards.subtitle: A comfortable downtown café environment
cards.notes: Bring a compact reading task or laptop session, order from the café, and keep your setup small enough for the available customer seating.
cards.short_summary: A daytime downtown setting for a shorter study session supported by a café purchase.
cards.evidence_claim: Visit Vallejo identifies Moschetti Café at 925 Marin Street and describes it as a French-inspired café with a comfortable environment serving coffee, pastries, quiches, and lunch.
cards.source_title: Moschetti Café
cards.access_notes: Commercial customer seating; the cited page lists Tuesday through Saturday service from 7:30 a.m. to 2 p.m. Confirm before traveling.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ceremonies and shipboard contests documented by Cal Poly Maritime Academy, from a cadet’s first cap to the final eight bells of commencement.

cards.title: Let Your Family Put the Cap On
cards.subtitle: The Corps welcome begins with a ceremonial first cap
cards.notes: Attend the Quad ceremony on move-in day and invite your family or supporters to take part in your formal welcome to the Corps.
cards.short_summary: New cadets ceremonially don their academy caps as they enter the Corps community.
cards.evidence_claim: The Fall 2025 orientation schedule placed Corps capping on the Quad after a dedicated practice, while the academy’s orientation FAQ says families participate on check-in day.
cards.source_title: Fall 2025 Orientation Schedule
cards.access_notes: Scheduled as part of academy orientation; participation and guest arrangements are set by the current orientation program.

cards.title: End the Class Watch with Eight Bells
cards.subtitle: A ship’s bell closes the graduating class’s watch
cards.notes: Listen for eight strikes near the close of commencement—the maritime signal turns graduation into the ceremonial end of a watch.
cards.short_summary: The graduating Corps commander marks the class’s completed watch with eight bell strikes.
cards.evidence_claim: Cal Maritime Magazine documented the graduating Corps commander ringing the bell eight times to signal the end of the class’s watch and identified it as a commencement tradition.
cards.source_title: Cal Maritime Magazine — Fall 2005
cards.access_notes: Associated with the academy’s commencement ceremony; ceremony access is governed by the current commencement plan.

cards.title: Live the Same Date Twice
cards.subtitle: International Date Line passage produced two June 22s
cards.notes: When the voyage crosses back over the Date Line, mark the repeated calendar day with its shipboard labels: the first date is A, the repeat is B.
cards.short_summary: Cadets aboard Golden Bear labeled consecutive occurrences of June 22 as 22A and 22B.
cards.evidence_claim: The academy’s 2025 voyage report says crossing back over the International Date Line produced a second June 22, with the two days called 22A and 22B.
cards.source_title: Our Second June 22
cards.access_notes: Occurs only when the Training Ship Golden Bear’s voyage route and Date Line crossing create a repeated date.

cards.entity_name: Hunt for King Neptune and the Golden Idol
cards.title: Search the Ship for King Neptune
cards.subtitle: A maritime scavenger hunt unfolds during Sinbad Games
cards.notes: Follow the official shipwide clues and puzzles with your division; take part only through the supervised Sinbad Games program.
cards.short_summary: Divisions solve maritime-themed clues while pursuing King Neptune and the Golden Idol.
cards.evidence_claim: The academy’s 2026 Sinbad Games account documents the Hunt for King Neptune and the Golden Idol as a shipwide scavenger hunt involving clues, challenges and maritime puzzles.
cards.source_title: More Than a Competition: The Sinbad Games
cards.access_notes: A supervised Summer Sea Term activity aboard Training Ship Golden Bear; follow shipboard boundaries and event instructions.

cards.title: Settle Division Pride with Push-Ups
cards.subtitle: Proper-form repetitions become an Olympics-at-sea event
cards.notes: Compete or cheer from the deck while event staff count proper-form repetitions; follow the organizers’ fitness and safety directions.
cards.short_summary: Cadets represent their divisions in a head-to-head proper-form push-up contest.
cards.evidence_claim: The academy’s 2026 account identifies the Push-Up Off as a Sinbad Games endurance contest decided by the most push-ups completed with proper form.
cards.source_title: More Than a Competition: The Sinbad Games
cards.access_notes: Conducted as an organized shipboard competition; participate only if cleared and follow event staff’s form and safety rules.

cards.title: Run a Triathlon Without Leaving the Ship
cards.subtitle: Endurance, speed and agility meet shipboard constraints
cards.notes: Join your division’s selected team or support from the designated viewing area as cadets tackle the supervised physical events.
cards.short_summary: A shipboard fitness challenge combines endurance, speed and agility during the annual games.
cards.evidence_claim: Cal Poly Maritime Academy’s 2026 Sinbad Games report describes the Triathlon as a fitness challenge combining endurance, speed and agility through shipboard physical events.
cards.source_title: More Than a Competition: The Sinbad Games
cards.access_notes: Available only through the organized Sinbad Games aboard the training ship; follow all fitness and shipboard safety controls.

cards.title: Race Seawater Through Leaky Buckets
cards.subtitle: Divisions try to fill a container before their rivals
cards.notes: Take your assigned place in the supervised line and pass each bucket carefully; the deliberately leaky equipment is part of the challenge.
cards.short_summary: Cadet lines transfer seawater bucket by bucket while holes complicate the race.
cards.evidence_claim: The 2025 academy voyage report documents a Bucket Brigade in which opposing divisions passed seawater along cadet lines to fill containers, with holes in some transfer buckets.
cards.source_title: Our Second June 22
cards.access_notes: An organized Sinbad Games event aboard Training Ship Golden Bear; handling seawater and deck equipment requires staff supervision.

cards.title: Turn a Boiler Suit into a Water Relay
cards.subtitle: Oversized workwear becomes division competition gear
cards.notes: Watch from the assigned deck area or participate only under event supervision; organizers control the suit, water and relay procedure.
cards.short_summary: Cadets use a boiler suit in a carefully organized water-transfer challenge.
cards.evidence_claim: The academy documented the Boiler Suit Hydro Test in both 2025 and 2026 as a Sinbad Games water challenge involving a boiler suit and division teamwork.
cards.source_title: More Than a Competition: The Sinbad Games
cards.access_notes: A supervised shipboard relay; do not recreate it independently or alter protective workwear outside the organized event.

cards.title: Repair the Pipe That Refuses to Cooperate
cards.subtitle: Cadets confront a deliberately troublesome water system
cards.notes: Work with your division to control the water using the supplied setup and tools; leave pressure changes to the designated game assistant.
cards.short_summary: Teams race to manage water moving through an intentionally difficult makeshift piping system.
cards.evidence_claim: The academy’s 2026 report identifies Plumber’s Nightmare as a team challenge to move water through a makeshift piping system with minimal spills.
cards.source_title: More Than a Competition: The Sinbad Games
cards.access_notes: Run only within the supervised Sinbad Games; water pressure and equipment are controlled by event organizers.

cards.title: Land a Heavy Line on the Bitts
cards.subtitle: Working-line accuracy becomes a deck competition
cards.notes: Throw only from the marked competition position after the deck is cleared; follow the event crew’s line-handling instructions.
cards.short_summary: Cadets test seamanship accuracy by casting a hawser toward a designated target.
cards.evidence_claim: The academy’s 2026 Sinbad Games story describes the Hawser Toss as a seamanship contest testing accuracy by throwing a heavy line at a designated target.
cards.source_title: More Than a Competition: The Sinbad Games
cards.access_notes: A supervised deck event involving a heavy line; spectators and competitors must follow the event crew’s safety perimeter.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Cal Poly Maritime Academy, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A conservative Saturday-to-Sunday sequence for getting oriented to the waterfront campus, trying core student spaces, and exploring Vallejo’s maritime setting.

cards.title: Saturday Morning: Learn Your Residence Hall
cards.subtitle: Begin where many first-year students live
cards.notes: Locate the Residence Life office and save its contact details, then learn the approved entrances and shared-space expectations for your assigned hall.
cards.short_summary: Start the weekend by understanding the residential resources available to new students.
cards.evidence_claim: The university identifies McAllister Residence Hall as suite-style housing that primarily accommodates first-year students; the Residence Life office is in Upper Residence Hall.
cards.source_title: Housing and Dining | Cal Poly Maritime Academy
cards.access_notes: Residence halls are student housing, not public attractions. Enter only your assigned hall or spaces where a resident or university staff member authorizes access.

cards.title: Saturday Brunch: Test the Marketplace Routine
cards.subtitle: Practice a normal weekend meal stop
cards.notes: Bring your campus payment method, scan the posted menu, and ask dining staff about ingredients or dietary needs before choosing a meal.
cards.short_summary: Use an early meal to learn how weekend campus dining works before classes begin.
cards.evidence_claim: The university identifies Marketplace Dining Center as its campus dining venue and states that weekend service runs from 11:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m.
cards.source_title: FAQ Dining & Cooking | California State University Maritime Academy
cards.access_notes: The cited legacy dining page lists Saturday and Sunday hours of 11:00 a.m.–7:00 p.m.; verify posted hours because academic breaks and campus integration may affect service.

cards.title: Saturday Midday: Map Your Student-Service Hub
cards.subtitle: Find the offices you may need later
cards.notes: Walk through authorized common areas and note where the Registrar, Admissions, Financial Aid, Career Services, and student gathering spaces are located.
cards.short_summary: Turn Mayo Hall into a familiar reference point for future administrative questions.
cards.evidence_claim: The university says renovated Mayo Hall contains lounges, study and leadership spaces plus student services including the Registrar, Admissions, Financial Aid and Career Services.
cards.source_title: Mayo Hall Renovation and Addition Project | Cal Maritime
cards.access_notes: Use public or student-authorized common areas only. Individual offices generally operate on weekday schedules and may be closed during a weekend visit.

cards.title: Saturday Afternoon: Preview the Library
cards.subtitle: Identify a future research and study base
cards.notes: Check the live calendar before leaving your residence hall, then locate service points and choose a study area that suits quiet or collaborative work.
cards.short_summary: Learn the library layout now so the first assignment does not become a navigation exercise.
